newsitem.title: ALBANIA: World Bank urges Albania to cut budget deficit.
newsitem.headline: World Bank urges Albania to cut budget deficit.

text.p: The World Bank representative in Albania, Carlos Elbirt, has urged the small Balkan country to take more steps to reduce its high budget deficit, the daily Koha Jone said on Tuesday.

"The main problem continues to remain the high budget deficit...The government is making attempts to reduce the budget deficit, nevertheless much remains to be done," Elbirt said in an interview with the daily.
Albania's budget deficit in June was 5.9 percent of gross domestic product, according to latest figures from the Albanian Institute of Statistics.

Albania should heighten competitiveness in the banking system but should also be cautious in giving licences to new banks, Ebirt said, adding an International Monetary Fund delegation would soon visit Tirana to discuss the budget.
